# Lab 14.4: Set Up HA VPN

## What We Are Going to Do
Connect two VPCs with HA VPN and BGP, simulating an on-premises network, with two tunnels for 99.99% availability.

## Steps

1. **Create two VPCs.** `vpc-a` is "cloud", `vpc-b` is "on-prem".


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud compute networks create vpc-a --subnet-mode=custom
gcloud compute networks subnets create a-sub --network=vpc-a --region=us-central1 --range=10.1.0.0/24
gcloud compute networks create vpc-b --subnet-mode=custom
gcloud compute networks subnets create b-sub --network=vpc-b --region=us-central1 --range=10.2.0.0/24</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **Create HA VPN gateways and Cloud Routers.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud compute vpn-gateways create gw-a --network=vpc-a --region=us-central1
gcloud compute vpn-gateways create gw-b --network=vpc-b --region=us-central1
gcloud compute routers create router-a --network=vpc-a --region=us-central1 --asn=65001
gcloud compute routers create router-b --network=vpc-b --region=us-central1 --asn=65002</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **Create two tunnels on each side.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SECRET=$(openssl rand -base64 24)
for i in 0 1; do
  gcloud compute vpn-tunnels create tunnel-a$i --region=us-central1 --ike-version=2 \
    --vpn-gateway=gw-a --interface=$i --peer-gcp-gateway=gw-b \
    --router=router-a --shared-secret=$SECRET
  gcloud compute vpn-tunnels create tunnel-b$i --region=us-central1 --ike-version=2 \
    --vpn-gateway=gw-b --interface=$i --peer-gcp-gateway=gw-a \
    --router=router-b --shared-secret=$SECRET
done</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


4. **Add BGP sessions.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">for i in 0 1; do
  gcloud compute routers add-interface router-a --region=us-central1 --interface-name=if-a$i \
    --ip-address=169.254.$i.1 --mask-length=30 --vpn-tunnel=tunnel-a$i
  gcloud compute routers add-bgp-peer router-a --region=us-central1 --peer-name=peer-a$i \
    --interface=if-a$i --peer-ip-address=169.254.$i.2 --peer-asn=65002
  gcloud compute routers add-interface router-b --region=us-central1 --interface-name=if-b$i \
    --ip-address=169.254.$i.2 --mask-length=30 --vpn-tunnel=tunnel-b$i
  gcloud compute routers add-bgp-peer router-b --region=us-central1 --peer-name=peer-b$i \
    --interface=if-b$i --peer-ip-address=169.254.$i.1 --peer-asn=65001
done</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


5. **Check status.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud compute vpn-tunnels list --format="table(name,status,detailedStatus)"
gcloud compute routers get-status router-a --region=us-central1 \
  --format="yaml(result.bgpPeerStatus,result.bestRoutes)"</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   Tunnels show `ESTABLISHED`, BGP peers show `UP`, and `router-a` learns `10.2.0.0/24`.

6. **Clean up.** Delete tunnels, routers, gateways, then subnets and networks.


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud compute vpn-tunnels delete tunnel-a0 tunnel-a1 tunnel-b0 tunnel-b1 --region=us-central1 --quiet
gcloud compute routers delete router-a router-b --region=us-central1 --quiet
gcloud compute vpn-gateways delete gw-a gw-b --region=us-central1 --quiet
gcloud compute networks subnets delete a-sub b-sub --region=us-central1 --quiet
gcloud compute networks delete vpc-a vpc-b --quiet</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Tunnels | Two per gateway, both established |
| Routing | Dynamic, learned through BGP |
| SLA | 99.99% with two tunnels to both interfaces |
| Encryption | IPsec over the internet |
